mapper.select: SELECT sr.request_no as requestNo, sr.request_name as requestName, rr.reservation_no as reservationNo FROM reservation_request rr INNER JOIN special_request sr ON rr.request_no = sr.request_no WHERE rr.reservation_no = #{reservationNo}

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, rs.checkin_date, rs.checkout_date) as dayCount, rs.reservation_no as reservationNo, STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as checkinDate, STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkout_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as checkoutDate, rs.reservation_status as reservationStatus, rs.reservation_details_request as reservationDetailsRequest, rs.residence_country as residenceCountry, rs.guest_name as guestName, rs.guest_phone_number as guestPhoneNumber, rs.guest_email as guestEmail, rs.member_no as memberNo, rs.room_no as roomNo, rs.accommodation_no as accommodationNo
FROM reservation rs
WHERE rs.member_no = #{memberNo}
AND (rs.reservation_status = 1 AND date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') < date_format(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') )
AND (rs.reservation_status = 1 AND date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') )
AND rs.reservation_status IN (0, 2)
ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') DESC

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, rs.checkin_date, rs.checkout_date) as dayCount, rs.reservation_no as reservationNo, STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as checkinDate, STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkout_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as checkoutDate, rs.reservation_status as reservationStatus, rs.reservation_details_request as reservationDetailsRequest, rs.residence_country as residenceCountry, rs.guest_name as guestName, rs.guest_phone_number as guestPhoneNumber, rs.guest_email as guestEmail, rs.member_no as memberNo, rs.room_no as roomNo, rs.accommodation_no as accommodationNo FROM reservation rs WHERE rs.member_no = #{memberNo} AND rs.reservation_no = #{reservationNo}

select rm.room_qty - IFNULL(sum(rs.room_no), 0) from room rm left outer join reservation rs on rm.room_no = rs.room_no
and #{getDate} between STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(date_add(rs.checkout_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') where rm.accommodation_no = #{accommodationNo} and rm.room_no = #{roomNo} group by rm.room_no
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_seq_no('410', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%y%m%d'))
INSERT INTO reservation ( reservation_no, checkin_date, checkout_date, reservation_status, reservation_details_request, residence_country, guest_name, guest_phone_number, guest_email, member_no, room_no, accommodation_no ) VALUES ( #{reservationNo}, #{checkinDate}, #{checkoutDate}, #{reservationStatus}, #{reservationDetailsRequest}, #{residenceCountry}, #{guestName}, #{guestPhoneNumber}, #{guestEmail}, #{memberNo}, #{roomNo}, #{accommodationNo} )
